headline: 27 contracts catalogued across Ethereum, Solana, and Plume Mainnet; 6 governance/admin and 21 protocol contracts.

findings.text: Etherscan name-tag search for 'Superstate USCC' and 'Superstate' returns 9 Ethereum mainnet addresses: USCC proxy, USTB proxy, AllowlistV3, RedemptionIdle, oracles, and implementation contract.

Official deployments doc at https://docs.superstate.com/investors/smart-contracts.md lists all contract addresses with roles across Ethereum mainnet, Sepolia testnet, Plume mainnet/testnet, and Solana mainnet/devnet.
Audits linked from docs include 11 0xMacro audits, ChainSecurity audit, and Zellic audit PDF. Additional Allowlist audits by OffsideLabs and Certora found in audit section.
GitHub repositories identified from docs: https://github.com/superstateinc/ustb (USTB), https://github.com/superstateinc/onchain-redemptions (on-chain redemptions).
Multi-chain enumeration complete: Ethereum mainnet (9 addresses), Solana mainnet (4 addresses), Plume mainnet (3 addresses); plus testnet variants for Ethereum and Solana.
No factory contracts identified requiring child enumeration; all core protocol contracts listed with explicit role labels.
Addresses classified using controlled vocabulary: 'token' (USCC/USTB proxies), 'admin' (AllowlistV3), 'oracle' (price oracles), 'proxy_admin' (implementation contracts), 'other' (RedemptionIdle).
All 27 addresses traced to fetched block-explorer pages, official docs, or audit PDFs; no snippet-only sightings.

rationale.verdict: Discovery complete. Enumerated 27 contracts across Ethereum, Solana, and Plume Mainnet from official deployments documentation, block explorers, and audits. No addresses discarded due to verification failure.

protocol_metadata.about: Superstate USCC is a tokenized Crypto Carry Fund offering qualified purchasers access to basis trading strategies across Bitcoin, Ether (including staking), and U.S. Treasury securities. The fund issues shares as ERC-20 (Ethereum), SPL Token 2022 (Solana), and ERC-20 (Plume) tokens with permissioned access via an allowlist system. Superstate provides the underlying infrastructure (FundOS) through which institutional investors can mint and redeem fund shares using USDC or USD, with daily NAV-based pricing and atomic on-chain settlement.
